falseSynonyms.zh: document 通常是一份個別文件；record 可以是一筆資料、檔案、歷史紀錄或更大集合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Please upload the signed document. The system keeps a record of every change.

falseSynonyms.zh: register 是結構化的正式名冊；record 的範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The council maintains a register of licensed businesses. The file contains a record of the inspection.

falseSynonyms.zh: account 是對事件／經歷的敘述；不是所有 record 都是 narrative。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The witness gave an account of the accident. The database contains a record of the payment.

falseSynonyms.zh: file 通常是一個人、案件或項目的資料集合；record 可以只是一筆資料。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The lawyer reviewed the client file. Each transaction creates a separate record.

falseSynonyms.zh: entry 是 database、ledger、register 裡的一筆單一紀錄。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The ledger contains one entry for each payment. The hospital keeps a complete record of treatment.

falseSynonyms.zh: log 特別強調按時間順序持續記錄事件／操作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The system log lists every login attempt. The document provides a record of consent.

falseSynonyms.zh: history 強調一段時間內累積的過往經歷／事件模式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The doctor reviewed her medical history. The clerk corrected one record in the database.

falseSynonyms.zh: record 可指文字／資料紀錄；recording 通常是聲音或影像錄製內容。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The database keeps a record of the call. The recording of the call was stored securely.
